news.headline: Five Cheetah Cubs Are Born!
news.body: Five healthy cheetah cubs were born on October 5 at a Smithsonian animal center in Virginia. Their mom, Zura, is taking good care of them. People can watch the cubs snuggle and nap on a live video camera called the Cheetah Cub Cam!

news.headline: A Waterlily So Big It Can Be Seen From Space
news.body: Scientists found a brand-new kind of giant waterlily in Colombia, a country in South America. Its lily pads can grow more than 6 feet wide! A plant expert first spotted it in photos someone shared online, then traveled there to find it.

news.headline: Animals Will Star on New Money
news.body: England is making new paper money with animals on it! More than 2.5 million votes picked the puffin, barn owl, bumblebee, and hedgehog. The bumblebee got the most votes of all.

fun_fact: Cheetahs are the fastest animals on land. They can sprint about 60 to 70 miles per hour, as fast as a car on the highway! 🏎️
